type.description: Defines the type of the condition (always "simple").

property.description: Reference to the property used to evaluate the condition.

oneOf.description: Checks if the referenced property's value is in the list of values defined in the condition.

equals.description: Checks if the referenced property's value is equal to the value defined in the condition.

isActive.description: Checks if the referenced property is currently active and not hidden by other conditions.

allOf.$comment: property#condition should not depend on property#id

id.description: Unique identifier of the property. Can be used to, for example, reference the property for checks.

condition.description: Object that defines when a property should be displayed in the properties panel and its value should be included in the XML.

allMatch.description: List of conditions that must all be met for the property to be active.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown in the property input field when it is empty. Can be used to show example input.

value.description: Default value to be used if the user does not provide a value or if the type is Hidden.

description.description: Hint text shown below the property input field.

label.description: Label text shown above the property input field.

type.description: The type of a control field.

editable.description: Defines whether users can edit the property in the properties panel. By default, all non-hidden properties are editable.

choices.description: List of choices for a Dropdown (one value) or a List (one checkbox per choice).

name.description: Display name for a choice in a dropdown field. Shown to the user.

value.description: Value for a choice in a dropdown field. Stored in the XML.

constraints.description: Object that contains rules to validate user input to the template.

notEmpty.description: The control field must not be empty.

minLength.description: The minimal length of a control field value.

maxLength.description: The maximal length for a control field value.

pattern.description: String or object that defines a regular expression that the user's input must match. For Map properties it applies to every value.

value.description: The value of the regular expression.

message.description: Custom error message to show when the user's input does not match the regular expression.

minItems.description: The minimal number of values of a List property.

maxItems.description: The maximal number of values of a List property.

keyPattern.description: Regular expression (string, or object with value and message) that user-added Map keys and input parameter names must match.

group.description: Group in the properties panel that the property belongs to.

allOf.description: List of properties of the element template.

itemType.description: Type of every List item. String (default) accepts any text, checked by constraints.pattern, minLength, and maxLength. Date accepts only an existing ISO date in the format YYYY-MM-DD, so empty items are flagged; constraints.pattern may narrow it further but is not required.

display.description: How a List with choices is shown: checklist (one checkbox per choice) or taglist (searchable dropdown with chips). Defaults to checklist for up to 10 choices and taglist otherwise.

mirrorOutputs.description: Keep an output mapping <name> = ${<name>} for every user-added input parameter (camunda:additionalInputParameters), so worker results with the same name reach the process.

optional.description: Do not persist the input or output parameter when its value is empty (camunda:inputParameter, camunda:outputParameter).

entries.description: Fixed keys of a Map property. Keys are defined by the template; users edit the values.

key.description: Map key stored in the XML.

id.description: Unique identifier of the entry within the template. Lets conditions reference the entry's value.

label.description: Label shown for this key in the properties panel.

type.description: How the value is edited: String (single line, default), Text (multi-line), Dropdown (one of choices), Boolean (checkbox storing true / false), or Hidden (fixed value, not shown).

value.description: Default value for this key. Boolean for type Boolean.

description.description: Hint text shown below the entry.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown in an empty String or Text entry.

constraints.description: Validation rules for this entry. Replace the constraints of the Map property for this entry.

notEmpty.description: The value must not be empty.

minLength.description: The minimal length of the value.

maxLength.description: The maximal length of the value.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match, as a string or { value, message }.

editable.description: Set to false to show the value read-only.

optional.description: Do not write the entry to the XML when its value is empty.

additionalEntries.description: Allow users to add their own keys to a Map property, in addition to the fixed entries.

binding.description: Object that defines how the property is mapped to BPMN or Camunda extensions. Required.

type.description: The type of a property binding.

name.description: The name of a property binding.

event.description: The event type of a property binding (camunda:executionListener).

scriptFormat.description: The script format of a property binding (camunda:outputParameter, camunda:inputParameter, camunda:executionListener, conditionExpression).

source.description: The source value of a property binding (camunda:outputParameter, camunda:out).

target.description: The target value of a property binding (camunda:in).

expression.description: Indicates whether the control field value is an expression (camunda:in, camunda:field).

variables.description: The variable mapping of a property binding (camunda:in).

sourceExpression.description: The string containing the expression for the source attribute (camunda:out).

$schema.description: Reference to the Element Template JSON schema this document follows.

name.description: Template name. Shown during template selection and editing of a templated element. Required.

description.description: Template description. Shown during template selection and editing of a templated element.

version.description: Optional version of the template. If you add a version to a template, it will be considered unique based on its ID and version. Two templates can have the same ID if their versions are different.

isDefault.description: Indicates whether the element template is a default template.

deprecated.description: Marks the template as deprecated. Value can be either a boolean or an object with a message and a link to migration documentation.

message.description: Optional message to describe migration path.

documentationRef.description: URL pointing to template documentation. Must be a valid http(s) URL.

appliesTo.description: List of BPMN types the template can be applied to. Required.

elementType.description: Object that sets the type of the element. Some properties require a specific value for elementType.

value.description: Specifies the target BPMN element type. The element is replaced with the specified type when a user applies the template. Required if using elementType.

metadata.description: Some custom properties for further configuration.

keywords.description: List of keywords to help users find the template. Used in search and filtering, but not displayed in the UI.

groups.description: List of custom groups to organize related fields in the properties panel.

id.description: Uniquely identifies a group object. Required if using groups.

label.description: The label of the group, shown as a section header in the properties panel. Required if using groups.

scopes.description: Special scoped bindings that allow you to configure nested elements.

properties.description: List of properties of a scope.

entriesVisible.description: Defines whether all property input fields are shown, even those normally hidden by the template.

oneOf.description: A list of element template configurations.
